title: Vertical 9:16 reframe of the talking-head edit
caption: The 16:9 talking-head edit reframed to a 1080x1920 vertical for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. The centre crop keeps the presenter; long caption lines and the wide edit timeline are cut, which is why a real vertical cut re-flows its captions.
prompt: Use the magnifito-variants skill to turn the Magnifito talking-head edit (showcase/videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4) into a vertical 9:16 clip for Reels and Shorts. Take 8 seconds from 2.7 s, centre-crop so the presenter and her captions stay in frame, and save it as work/vertical.mp4.
